name: Find bar
description: Find and replace text in a document, sheet or log, with a match count and controls to step through matches.

classes.ayy-find-bar--floating: Positions the bar at the inline end of its containing block.

default.looks: A surface with input, count and navigation controls.

hover.when: Hover on a button or input
hover.looks: The control uses its own hover style.

pressed.looks: The button uses its own pressed style.

focus.looks: The control uses its own focus ring.

disabled.looks: Navigation and replacement buttons are disabled.

selected.looks: The button has a primary tint and text.

error.when: A nonempty query has no matches
error.looks: The query has aria-invalid and the count says No results.

loading.none: The app counts matches; show the old count until the new one arrives.

sizes.density: Inputs and buttons follow the control density and size scope.
sizes.width: Fills the container; rows wrap when space is limited.

js: findBarClass({ floating?, className? }); findBarCountText(query, current, total, labels?); findBarLabels.

FindBar.renders: div.ayy-find-bar with query, count and controls

props.matchCase / onMatchCaseChange: boolean and callback — optional case control
props.floating: boolean — float at the inline end
props.labels: Partial<FindBarLabels> — translated control names and count

a11y: Inputs and icon buttons have accessible names; the count is a live region.
Enter and Shift+Enter step matches; Escape closes. Enter during IME composition does nothing.
do: Use a find bar to find and replace text in a document, sheet or log.
Pass the current match and count from the app, and translate labels.
dont: Don't use a find bar to filter a list of records — use a Search bar.
